title: Command Pattern CLI Dispatcher
instructions: In `commands.py` make `Command` an abstract base class and implement `CommandExecutor`, `RegisterUser` and `SettleUpUser`. The executor runs the first matching command and turns `CommandError` into `Error: ...`. Matching must be exact, so use `fullmatch` and word checks, not `startswith`, and `matches` must never raise.

evidence.label: Registers a user storing only the hashed password, and rejects a duplicate phone
SettleUp joins the lines or reports Nothing to settle, passing the parsed user id
Loose or malformed input falls through to Invalid command with no side effects
The first matching command wins, and new Command subclasses plug in unchanged
Only CommandError becomes an Error message; other exceptions propagate
Command is abstract and cannot be instantiated
Register rejects extra words, short or long phones and odd names
matches() returns a bool, never raising, even for empty or Unicode input
